name: Herod
summary: The king of Judaea when Jesus was born in Bethlehem. Troubled by news of a newborn King of the Jews, he tried to find and kill the child.

key_moments.title: Troubled by the Wise Men
key_moments.description: Wise men came to Jerusalem asking where the newborn King of the Jews was, and Herod was troubled. He secretly asked them when the star appeared and sent them to Bethlehem, but God warned them in a dream not to return to him.

key_moments.title: Orders the Children of Bethlehem Killed
key_moments.description: When Herod saw the wise men had tricked him, he was furious. He had all the children in and around Bethlehem aged two and under killed.

key_moments.title: Dies, and Archelaus Reigns
key_moments.description: After Herod died, an angel told Joseph in Egypt that those who sought the child's life were dead. Herod's son Archelaus then reigned in Judaea in his place.
